final: WITH currency_avgs AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_currency_rebate FROM currency_avgs) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS avg_of_qualifying_rebates, AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.mean_currency_rebate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM currency_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_rebate > b.mean_currency_rebate
